name: The 80-Year Collapse
claim: A debt-driven collapse of the US economy is imminent — the '80-year big cycle' is ending. The predicted mechanism rotates with the news cycle; since mid-2026 it runs through the AI boom (debt-financed AI capex as the trigger).
born_note: Earliest ledger entry: Dalio's 'Fed risks repeating 1937' warning.

trigger.title: Ray Dalio: I Predicted The 2008 CRASH, I Know What Comes Next!
trigger.note: 135K views in its first 3 hours on 30 Jul 2026; 3.9M within a week. Published under a rotating title — first seen as 'Billionaires Warning: AI Will Lose You Money… You Should Be Happy' with 'The 80 Year Collapse Is Here' thumbnail. Audit verdict: a genuinely new interview, NOT a re-cut of the Sept 2025 DOAC episode — but its clips ecosystem invents figures around it (a '60% crash' title whose number never appears in the interview).

mutations.mechanism: Fed repeating 1937 — tightening into a downturn
'Phase 5' of the Big Debt Cycle — an 'economic heart attack' within ~3 years
capital war — money weaponized; gold as the hedge
AI capex as the crisis vector
